Injiniyring ki parhaee kar aaeeaaeeti aur enaaaeeti jaise pratishthit sansthanon men dakhila lene ka sapna dekhne vale chhatron ke lie pratiyogi pariksha ka dabav kisi bari chunauti se kam nahin hota. bord pariksha ke ank, jeeeee-men aur jeeeee-edvans ki taiyari ke bich vidyarthiyon ko simit avasron men apna sarvashreshth pradarshan karna parta hai. kaee bar achchhi taiyari ke bavjud pariksha ke din tabiyat kharab hone ya dusri paristhitiyon ke karan unka pradarshan prabhavit ho jata hai
